name: Simone
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features deep espresso roots and a rich dark chocolate brown base that carries through the ends. Fine toasted caramel highlights are woven through the back and sides, adding warmth and dimension. Two bold honey blonde pieces frame the face, creating the strongest contrast against the deep brunette.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
features: Bleached Knots/HD diamond lace/ Single knots
